findings.evidence: spec.md line 19: "The token file location SHALL be read-denied inside the sandbox." In template/scripts/sandboxed_writer.py, build_profile builds deny_read only from DENY_READ_HOME, protected and platform. launch_sandboxed_writer never passes the token_file path to build_profile, and build_profile has no parameter for it. A token_file outside ~/.config/dev-platform, ~/.claude and the other listed paths is readable by the writer. The tests do not cover this.
findings.summary: The spec requires the token file location to be read-denied inside the sandbox, but the generated profile does not add it. The token_file path is operator-configurable and may lie outside the denied directories.

findings.evidence: proposal.md: "denyWrite the integration checkout, its shared gitdir and every registered worktree, the push remote path when local". launch_sandboxed_writer calls build_profile(checkout=..., home=..., tmp=..., protected=protected_paths(integration_root), platform_root=...) with no extra_deny_write. protected_paths does not read the remote URL either.
findings.summary: The proposal says the profile write-denies the push remote path when it is local. build_profile accepts extra_deny_write, but launch_sandboxed_writer never computes or passes the push remote path, so a local remote is not protected.
